task: Fix 3 remaining TypeScript errors in src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: (1) line 62 'Cannot find name monthlyTrend' caused by MonthlyTrendTable defined at module scope referencing a useMemo binding inside DashboardPage; (2) line 74 'Parameter d implicitly has any' caused by the broken typeof-monthlyTrend prop type; (3) line 235 EmptyState variant='no-data' not in EmptyStateProps (no-data is the default but a stricter build flagged the explicit prop, and the component was also being given children which are not part of EmptyStateProps).

fixes.fix: Introduced module-scope interface MonthlyTrendRow { month: string; revenue: number; expenses: number; netIncome: number; } and changed MonthlyTrendTable prop type from { data: typeof monthlyTrend } to { data: MonthlyTrendRow[] } so the type no longer depends on a hook-scoped binding.

fixes.error: TS7006 Parameter 'd' implicitly has an 'any' type
fixes.fix: Annotated the map callback: data.map((d: MonthlyTrendRow) => ( ... )). With the prop type now correctly typed, this explicit annotation also satisfies strict noImplicitAny.

fixes.error: (preventive) useMemo return type was inferred loosely
fixes.fix: Annotated the Array.from(...).map(...) call as .map<MonthlyTrendRow>(...) so the hook returns MonthlyTrendRow[] and matches the MonthlyTrendTable prop type exactly.

fixes.error: TS2322 'variant' / children prop not assignable to EmptyStateProps
fixes.fix: Removed the redundant variant='no-data' (it is the EmptyState default). Additionally extracted the 3-step getting-started grid out of EmptyState as a sibling element so EmptyState no longer receives children (which are not part of EmptyStateProps). The three numbered step cards now render above the EmptyState in the same wrapper div, preserving the original visual intent.

notes: EmptyStateProps in src/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx does list 'no-data' as a valid variant, so the build error was the result of a stricter type-check snapshot / cache at agent-launch time. Removing the explicit variant avoids future drift and matches the component's documented default. The children-strip also aligns the call site with the EmptyState contract (title, description, icon, action).
